description: ¡Hola! Soy estudiante de electrónica enfocado en revolucionar el análisis de salud espacial. Combino sistemas embebidos, tecnología, enfermedad e innovación para crear soluciones de software inteligentes autónomos que mejoren el bienestar de los astronautas más allá de la Tierra.
summary:
Who is MUNDO?

MUNDO is a super intelligence meticulously created to be a friend in moments of loneliness, a psychologist for the times when emotions overwhelm you, and an early warning system for health problems. In addition to this, MUNDO takes care of you all the time, checking your mental, physical, and emotional health, as well as your mental balance
Its operating system is based on three parts:
It has two connected boards: that host MUNDO and its website: a Mega Prototype Shield and a MilkV DuoS.
-The board is connected: to a blood pressure monitor and an oximeter, which are responsible for taking data and sending it to the board's internal server.
-By simply connecting the board: to any compatible device—whether a cell phone, computer, tablet, or television—and accessing its website, MUNDO will be able to function in just a few minutes, without the need for an internet connection or Bluetooth
MUNDO would be a perfect companion on Earth, since there are many children in orphanages who just want someone to pay attention to them, and elderly people in hospitals in conditions of abandonment who would love to have someone listen to them. Most importantly, it would act as a containment barrier to lower the suicide rate, since there are people who are unable to relate socially or simply have no one to listen to them. The best part of all this is that MUNDO is a truly affordable product: just the MUNDO box, excluding the medical devices, has an approximate value of $30 per box
details:
MUNDO has these other specific functions:

  • Emotions: It is capable of analyzing facial expressions, tones of voice, and manner of speaking.
  • Language: It can speak Spanish and English.
  • Environment: It can adapt to Earth, Mars, the Moon, and hazardous areas.
  • Data Protection: All data collected by MUNDO is solely and exclusively for observation purposes and is not shared with other super intelligences.
  • Health: It can analyze medical data.
  • Guidance: It is capable of providing textual and illustrative information for basic medical procedures.
  • Testing: MUNDO also prompts you to perform daily tests to check physical health, internal health, and sanity.
  • Heat Map: All information collected—such as hours of sleep, amount of work, discomfort, pain, and injuries—is displayed by MUNDO on a heat map.
  • The programming languages used were Python, JavaScript, HTML, and C++.
  • MUNDO is a super intelligence built with great care and very strict limitations, so it is not capable of hallucinating or lying to the user, and its memory is completely limited to the data provided by NASA.
  • Due to issues regarding materials and logistics, the project presented is a simulation of how the actual project functions, as shown in the video..
